hero.description: Teko is an innovative platform focused on pediatric mental health and neuropsychology. We connect clinics, psychologists, children, and parents in a unified ecosystem, transforming complex evaluations into engaging experiences through Serious Games.

about.description: Teko is an innovative platform focused on pediatric mental health and child psychology. It connects Psychologists, Children, and Parents in the same ecosystem, converting complex assessments into playful experiences.
about.psychologist_desc: Centralized management and rich diagnostic data.

science.desc1: The application moves beyond paper tests (tiring and often biased) to adopt computerized paradigms (such as Go/No-Go and spatial mazes) masked beneath a high-quality Serious Game.
science.desc2: Built upon validated scientific literature, Teko offers pinpoint telemetry collection, providing precise quantitative reports to assist diagnostic decisions (such as ADHD screening and executive function tracking).

mobile.description: Clinical evaluation right in your patient's pocket. Take Serious Games anywhere. Allow complementary assessments and playful progress tracking to happen in the comfort of home.

equipe.subtitle: Meet the multidisciplinary team bringing together clinical precision, empathetic design, and cutting-edge engineering to redefine pediatric psychometric assessment.
equipe.mavi_bio: Leading product vision and user experience, Maria Victoria ensures Teko remains intuitive and welcoming for children and psychologists alike. Her focus on maximizing product value and crafting empathetic user journeys is core to our brand identity, translating clinical complexity into joyful interactions.
equipe.carlos_bio: As system architect, Carlos leads fullstack development and artificial intelligence pipelines. He oversees critical engineering decisions, ensuring the platform is robust, scalable, and strictly compliant with security standards and data privacy regulations (LGPD), safeguarding sensitive patient data.
equipe.miguel_bio: Miguel bridges financial strategy and data analytics to drive Teko's sustainable growth. A specialist in KPIs and algorithmic validation, he converts complex metrics into actionable business insights. His analytical drive is complemented by key contributions to frontend engineering.

validacao.subtitle: Our serious games convert complex neuropsychological evaluations into engaging clinical data, offering a clear window into child cognitive development without traditional test anxiety.
validacao.academic_desc: All Teko dynamics are strictly grounded in Master's and Doctoral research, building a solid bridge between cutting-edge academic knowledge and real-world clinical practice.
validacao.inibicao_desc: Our playful adaptation of the 'Tap Fast!' paradigm accurately measures inhibitory control and impulse management. By turning static stimuli into interactive challenges, we capture natural reactions essential for evaluating a child's self-regulation in real-world scenarios.
validacao.velocidade_desc: Evaluates processing speed and decision-making under time pressure. Goalkeeper requires the child to react quickly to intercept goal kicks. Collected data tracks reaction time per save with millisecond precision, measuring cognitive agility.
validacao.foco_desc: Evaluates sustained attention and visual tracking skills. In Forest Photographer, the child explores an interactive environment to locate and 'photograph' specific animals among distractors. The system logs discovery speed, correct photos, and false positives.
